newsitem.title: USA: ARCO, Anadarko join in Cook Inlet exploration.
newsitem.headline: ARCO, Anadarko join in Cook Inlet exploration.

text.p: Atlantic Richfield unit ARCO Alaska Inc. and Andarko Petroleum Corp. have struck an agreement to combine their exploration efforts in part of southcentral Alaska's Cook Inlet, officials said.
The two-year alliance will cover 127,000 onshore and offshore acres of ARCO's upper Cook Inlet leasehold, the companies said.
An ARCO Alaska spokesman said Friday that Anadarko's seismic technology could prove fruitful in the Cook Inlet area, Alaska's oldest oil-producing region.
"Oil exploration really is about the application of new ideas, sometimes to old areas," ARCO Alaska spokesman Ronnie Chappell said. "New ideas and a fresh perspective can be very valuable."
The agreement does not include the Sunfish prospect, which was discovered by ARCO and partner Phillips Petroleum, or the Beluga River gas field.
The alliance was unveiled Thursday. Financial terms were not revealed.
Under the agreement, Houston-based Anadarko will manage an Anchorage-based exploration team made up of geoscientists from both companies, officials said.
Anadarko will serve as operator and earn a 50 percent share of ARCO's working interest in Cook Inlet leases by conducting new exploration work, officials said.
That work will include seismic surveys, completion of geological and geophysical studies and drilling of exploration wells, the companies said.
Chappell said ARCO will benefit from its expanded partnership with Anadarko, which has joined with Arco in exploring the North Slope's Colville River Delta area.
"We've been acting with them on the North Slope and we felt like it was a really good fit," he said.
Anadarko has had impressive exploration successes elsewhere, Chappell said.
An Anadarko official said that company will also benefit from the Cook Inlet partnership, which was effective September 1.
"This agreement joins two companies with complementary strengths," John Seitz, Anadarko's senior vice president for exploration, said in a news release issued Thursday.

"ARCO has long experience in Alaska, tremendous knowledge of the area and the largest land position in Cook Inlet. Anadarko will bring a new look and a fresh, creative perspective to evaluatoin of that resource base," Seitz said.
